entries.title: Little Shrew
entries.notes:
Gentle, quietly magical picture book by Akiko Miyakoshi (Kids Can Press,
2024). Little Shrew is diligent in all parts of his life — a sweet story
about appreciating life's little pleasures.

**Buy for Tuesday** (daughter) — picture book for a ~2-year-old.

entries.title: Coyote vs. Acme
entries.notes:
Coyote vs. Acme — the long-delayed Looney Tunes movie where Wile E. Coyote
sues Acme for the defective products that keep backfiring on him. Live-action
with animated characters, John Cena as the Acme lawyer.

**In theaters Aug 28, 2026.** Not yet on streaming/VOD — notify Peter the
moment it's available for digital rental or on a streaming service.

entries.title: Hope
entries.notes:
Hope (2026) — Na Hong-jin's first film since The Wailing (2016). A South
Korean village police chief and his rookie deputy defend their community
from a mysterious creature after wildfires sever communications — which
turns out to be an alien searching for its offspring. Stars Hwang Jung-min,
Zo In-sung, Hoyeon, Taylor Russell, Alicia Vikander, and Michael Fassbender.

Released in US theaters Sep 9, 2026. In theaters now — watch for
streaming/rental.

entries.title: Tony
entries.notes:
Tony (2026) — A24 biopic about a 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain (Dominic Sessa)
who travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a
restaurant kitchen, setting off the journey that made him a legend.

Released Aug 21, 2026. **94% on Rotten Tomatoes.** In theaters now — watch
for streaming/rental.

entries.title: You Can See Everything
entries.notes:
You Can See Everything (2026) — Nathan Fielder and Lance Oppenheim's
documentary following Elizabeth Holmes in the 34 days before she began her
federal prison sentence, continuing over three years. Holmes invited Fielder
and Oppenheim into her home to document her final days of freedom.

Features Amanda Seyfried, who portrayed Holmes in *The Dropout*, joining the
film in meta fashion to dramatize Holmes's contemporary life.

Premiered as a secret screening at Telluride Film Festival on Sep 6, 2026.
Theatrical release by A24 on Oct 16, 2026.
